items.title: How Cyberattacks Affect Individuals and Organizations

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic How Cyberattacks Affect Individuals and Organizations under 9.2 as printed (PDF 126, printed 122).

blocks.text: Cyberattacks can cause serious damage to both individuals and organizations. People may lose personal files, passwords, or money, while companies may face data breaches and loss of customer trust. Attacks can stop business operations, harm reputations, and lead to financial losses. Even schools and hospitals can be affected by cyber incidents.
